_note: A harness-owned, simplified extraction prompt/schema (see golden_dataset.py's SYSTEM_PROMPT) — not a byte-identical copy of app/requirements/parser.py's production prompt, so comparing local-vs-production models here doesn't require refactoring production code. wet_room_interpretation cases are reused from tests/wet_room_corpus/corpus.json (idx noted per case) but simplified to a bare wet_rooms COUNT, not the finer kind/host resolution that corpus tests at the normalizer layer — that finer logic is deterministic (wet_room_normalizer.py) and already covered by tests/wet_room_corpus, not re-tested here. public_open_side is intentionally absent: it is set from a structured UI field (Project.public_open_side), never extracted by the LLM parser (confirmed by reading app/requirements/parser.py's RequirementExtraction schema and app/demo/requirements_view.py's _public_open_side_of) — see tests/ai_harness/test_deterministic_examples.py for its Tier-A test instead.
